working_definition: Authors call this cluster dFB, dorsal fan-shaped body neurons.

best_match.fbbt_term: adult dorsal fan-shaped body tangential neuron
best_match.fbbt_definition: Any fan-shaped body tangential neuron that arborizes across a dorsal layer (6-9) of the fan-shaped body. Some of these neurons are involved in sleep regulation (Donlea et al., 2011; Donlea et al., 2014; Qian et al., 2017; Ni et al., 2019).

justification: Authors name the dorsal fan-shaped body neuron class; FBbt adult dorsal fan-shaped body tangential neuron is that class.
